text.11:106: As for those who will be wretched (on that day) they will be in the Fire; sighing and wailing will be their portion therein,
text.20:2: We have not revealed unto thee (Muhammad) this Qur'an that thou shouldst be distressed,
text.20:117: Therefor we said: O Adam! This is an enemy unto thee and unto thy wife, so let him not drive you both out of the Garden so that thou come to toil.
text.20:123: He said: Go down hence, both of you, one of you a foe unto the other. But when there come unto you from Me a guidance, then whoso followeth My guidance, he will not go astray nor come to grief.
